d:
Jethalal plans a 5-day family trip to his homeland Kutch to attend the Rann Utsav and visit the Ashapura Mata temple (fulfilling Daya's prayer for Champaklal's safe return). While Taarak, Bhide, and Dr. Hathi are unable to join due to work and family commitments, Sodhi and Gogi decide to tag along. Later, Iyer and Babita, followed by Goli, also join the group, sending Bagha into a scramble to arrange last-minute train tickets.
Are you ready for the challenge?
